response.query: Provide studies relevant to: Recurrence plot and change quantile-based deep supervised and semi-supervised protection for transmission lines connected to photovoltaic plants, topics discussed:
response.answer: Recurrence plots and change quantile-based methods are used for advanced protection schemes in photovoltaic plant-connected transmission lines. Deep supervised and semi-supervised learning enhances fault detection. These techniques improve reliability and safety in power transmission systems.
